quote: In this experiment, hyperoxia conditions were created by increasing the oxygen content, and hypoxic conditions were created by increasing the nitrogen content.
statement: 通过增加氧气含量创造高氧条件，通过增加氮气含量创造低氧条件。
text_zh: 通过增加氧气含量创造高氧条件，通过增加氮气含量创造低氧条件。
text_en: High-oxygen conditions are created by increasing oxygen content, and low-oxygen conditions are created by increasing nitrogen content.

quote: The species grows rapidly in size, however, it suffers from many environmental challenges since its growth is related to temperature and oxygen conditions (Tetreault, Fogle & Guerdat, 2021 ; Jiang et al., 2021b ; Nitz et al., 2020).
statement: Crucian carp growth is linked to temperature and oxygen conditions, causing them to suffer from environmental challenges.
text_en: Crucian carp growth is linked to temperature and oxygen conditions, causing them to suffer from environmental challenges.

quote: Temperature plays a key role in the physiological state and ecosystem function of fish, and maintaining the appropriate temperature is important for aquaculture management (Lindmark, Ohlberger & Gardmark, 2021 ; Burt, Hinch & Patterson, 2011 ; O’Gorman et al., 2016 ; Barbieri, deMedeiros & Henriques, 2016 ; Barbieri & Bondioli, 2015).
statement: Maintaining appropriate temperature is important for aquaculture management because it affects fish physiological state.
text_en: Maintaining appropriate temperature is important for aquaculture management because it affects fish physiological state.

quote: Enzyme activity, metabolic rate, and immunoglobulin levels can be affected by sudden changes in temperature, thereby affecting fish survival (Kumar, 2021 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Magouz et al., 2021).
statement: Sudden temperature changes affect enzyme activity, metabolic rate, and immunoglobulin levels, which impacts fish survival.
text_en: Sudden temperature changes affect enzyme activity, metabolic rate, and immunoglobulin levels, which impacts fish survival.

quote: Temperature conditions that are not ideal can inhibit growth, decrease antibacterial ability, disrupt the physiological balance, and may even cause death (Wang et al., 2021a ; Neves et al., 2021).
statement: Non-ideal temperatures inhibit growth, reduce antibacterial ability, disrupt physiological balance, and can cause death.
text_en: Non-ideal temperatures inhibit growth, reduce antibacterial ability, disrupt physiological balance, and can cause death.

quote: Oxygen is an indispensable element for every aquatic animal to maintain metabolic activity (Alver, Føre & Alfredsen, 2021), and it is also one of the crucial limiting factors in aquaculture production (Vakili et al., 2021 ; Lv et al., 2021).
statement: Oxygen is essential for metabolic activity and is a crucial limiting factor in aquaculture production.
text_en: Oxygen is essential for metabolic activity and is a crucial limiting factor in aquaculture production.

quote: The growth parameters, hematological parameters, and apoptotic indices of fish are reduced by hypoxic conditions (Salem, Abdel-Ghany & Almisherfi, 2021 ; Álvarez et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2020).
statement: Hypoxic conditions reduce growth parameters, hematological parameters, and apoptotic indices in fish.
text_en: Hypoxic conditions reduce growth parameters, hematological parameters, and apoptotic indices in fish.

quote: Environmental stress causes amino acid metabolism disorder in fish, which in turn interferes with aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis and protein digestion and absorption, which has been found in olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) [ 40 ], swordtail fish (Xiphophorus helleri) [ 50 ], and common carp (Cyprinus carpio) [ 51 ].
statement: 环境胁迫导致鱼类氨基酸代谢紊乱，进而干扰氨酰-tRNA生物合成以及蛋白质的消化和吸收。
text_zh: 环境胁迫导致鱼类氨基酸代谢紊乱，进而干扰氨酰-tRNA生物合成以及蛋白质的消化和吸收。
text_en: Environmental stress causes amino acid metabolism disorders in fish, thereby interfering with aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis and protein digestion and absorption.
outcome: 氨基酸代谢紊乱与蛋白质消化吸收

quote: Numerous studies have proved that exposure to saline-alkali can disrupt the lipid metabolism of aquatic animals [ 53 , 54 ].
statement: 许多研究证明，暴露于盐碱环境中会破坏水生动物的脂质代谢。
text_zh: 许多研究证明，暴露于盐碱环境中会破坏水生动物的脂质代谢。
text_en: Many studies have demonstrated that exposure to saline-alkaline environments disrupts lipid metabolism in aquatic animals.

quote: Liu et al. [ 3 ] reported that carbonate alkali exposure induced significant changes in metabolites and gene expression levels in lipid metabolism, including glycerophospholipid metabolism, sphingolipid metabolism and arachidonic acid metabolism in crucian carp.
statement: 碳酸碱暴露诱导了鲫鱼脂质代谢中代谢物和基因表达水平的显著变化，包括甘油磷脂代谢、鞘脂代谢和花生四烯酸代谢。
text_zh: 碳酸碱暴露诱导了鲫鱼脂质代谢中代谢物和基因表达水平的显著变化，包括甘油磷脂代谢、鞘脂代谢和花生四烯酸代谢。
text_en: Carbonate alkali exposure induced significant changes in metabolite and gene expression levels in lipid metabolism of crucian carp, including glycerophospholipid metabolism, sphingolipid metabolism, and arachidonic acid metabolism.

quote: Song et al. [ 55 ] showed that Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) were more inclined to use lipid metabolism for energy supply in adapting to high concentrations of saline-alkaline water.
statement: 尼罗罗非鱼在适应高浓度盐碱水时更倾向于利用脂质代谢供能。
text_zh: 尼罗罗非鱼在适应高浓度盐碱水时更倾向于利用脂质代谢供能。
text_en: Nile tilapia tend to rely more on lipid metabolism for energy when adapting to high-concentration saline-alkaline water.

quote: As shown in Fig. 5A , HCT at 24 °C was significantly higher than that at 18 °C and 30 °C.
statement: 24°C时的红细胞压积（HCT）显著高于18°C和30°C。
text_zh: 24°C时的红细胞压积（HCT）显著高于18°C和30°C。
text_en: The hematocrit (HCT) at 24°C was significantly higher than at 18°C and 30°C.

quote: At the same temperature, the HCT of hypoxia was higher than that of hyperoxia and moderate oxygen (P
statement: 在相同温度下，低氧条件下的血细胞比容（HCT）高于高氧和中氧条件。
text_zh: 在相同温度下，低氧条件下的血细胞比容（HCT）高于高氧和中氧条件。
text_en: At the same temperature, hematocrit (HCT) under hypoxic conditions was higher than under hyperoxic and normoxic conditions.

quote: Under the same temperature conditions, MCH under hypoxic conditions was significantly higher than that under hyperoxia and medium oxygen condition (P
statement: 在相同温度条件下，低氧条件下的平均红细胞血红蛋白量（MCH）显著高于高氧和中氧条件。
text_zh: 在相同温度条件下，低氧条件下的平均红细胞血红蛋白量（MCH）显著高于高氧和中氧条件。
text_en: Under the same temperature conditions, the mean corpuscular hemoglobin (MCH) under hypoxic conditions was significantly higher than that under hyperoxic and mesoxic conditions.

quote: Fig. 5C , at the same temperature, HGB under hypoxic conditions was higher than that under medium oxygen and hyperoxia conditions.
statement: 图5C显示，在相同温度下，低氧条件下的血红蛋白（HGB）高于中氧和高氧条件。
text_zh: 图5C显示，在相同温度下，低氧条件下的血红蛋白（HGB）高于中氧和高氧条件。
text_en: Figure 5C shows that at the same temperature, hemoglobin (HGB) levels under low oxygen conditions were higher than those under medium and high oxygen conditions.

quote: Under hypoxic conditions, the FW of crucian carp in L30 was lower than that in L18 and L24 (P
statement: 在低氧条件下，L30组鲫鱼的终末体重（FW）低于L18和L24组。
text_zh: 在低氧条件下，L30组鲫鱼的终末体重（FW）低于L18和L24组。
text_en: Under hypoxic conditions, the final body weight (FW) of crucian carp in the L30 group was lower than that in the L18 and L24 groups.

quote: bioaccumulation, oxidative stress, cell apoptosis, and inflammation induced by lead (Pb) in Channa argus.
statement: 铅（Pb）在乌鳢中诱导生物累积、氧化应激、细胞凋亡和炎症。
text_zh: 铅（Pb）在乌鳢中诱导生物累积、氧化应激、细胞凋亡和炎症。
text_en: Lead (Pb) induces bioaccumulation, oxidative stress, apoptosis and inflammation in snakehead fish.

quote: Integrated profiling of global metabolomic and transcriptomic responses to viral hemorrhagic septicemia virus infection in olive flounder.
statement: 对橄榄比目鱼感染病毒性出血性败血症病毒后的整体代谢组学和转录组学反应进行综合分析。
text_zh: 对橄榄比目鱼感染病毒性出血性败血症病毒后的整体代谢组学和转录组学反应进行综合分析。
text_en: Comprehensive analysis of the overall metabolomic and transcriptomic responses of olive flounder after infection with viral hemorrhagic septicemia virus.

quote: Study on the timing sequence of two pathway of Oreochromis niloticus ammonia metabolism under the stress of carbonate alkalinity.
statement: 研究碳酸盐碱度胁迫下尼罗罗非鱼氨代谢两条途径的时间序列。
text_zh: 研究碳酸盐碱度胁迫下尼罗罗非鱼氨代谢两条途径的时间序列。
text_en: Study the time series of two pathways of ammonia metabolism in Nile tilapia under carbonate alkalinity stress.

quote: Ammonia production, excretion, toxicity, and defense in fish: A review.
statement: 关于鱼类氨产生、排泄、毒性及防御机制的综述。
text_zh: 关于鱼类氨产生、排泄、毒性及防御机制的综述。
text_en: A review on ammonia production, excretion, toxicity, and defense mechanisms in fish.

quote: Threonine deficiency decreased intestinal immunity and aggravated inflammation associated with NF-κB and target of rapamycin signalling pathways in juvenile grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) after infection with Aeromonas hydrophila.
statement: 苏氨酸缺乏降低了草鱼幼鱼的肠道免疫力，并加剧了嗜水气单胞菌感染后与NF-κB和雷帕霉素靶蛋白信号通路相关的炎症。
text_zh: 苏氨酸缺乏降低了草鱼幼鱼的肠道免疫力，并加剧了嗜水气单胞菌感染后与NF-κB和雷帕霉素靶蛋白信号通路相关的炎症。
text_en: Threonine deficiency reduced intestinal immunity in juvenile grass carp and exacerbated inflammation associated with NF-κB and mTOR signaling pathways following Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: Indirect effect of different dietary protein to energy ratio of bait fish mori diets on growth performance, body composition, nitrogen metabolism and relative AMPK & mTOR pathway gene expression of Chinese perch.
statement: 不同饲料蛋白能量比对鳜生长性能、体组成、氮代谢及AMPK和mTOR通路基因表达的间接影响。
text_zh: 不同饲料蛋白能量比对鳜生长性能、体组成、氮代谢及AMPK和mTOR通路基因表达的间接影响。
text_en: Indirect effects of different dietary protein-to-energy ratios on growth performance, body composition, nitrogen metabolism, and gene expression of the AMPK and mTOR pathways in mandarin fish.

quote: The survival rate of crucian carp under hyperoxia conditions was significantly higher than that under mesoxia and hypoxia conditions.
statement: 高氧条件下鲫鱼的存活率显著高于中氧和低氧条件。
text_zh: 高氧条件下鲫鱼的存活率显著高于中氧和低氧条件。
text_en: The survival rate of crucian carp under high oxygen conditions was significantly higher than that under medium and low oxygen conditions.

quote: When the ambient temperature was the same, the growth under hyperoxia conditions was higher than that under mesoxia and hypoxia conditions.
statement: 在相同环境温度下，高氧条件下的生长高于中氧和低氧条件。
text_zh: 在相同环境温度下，高氧条件下的生长高于中氧和低氧条件。
text_en: At the same environmental temperature, growth under high oxygen conditions was higher than under medium and low oxygen conditions.

quote: Therefore, growth may be inhibited by hypoxia (Beemelmanns et al., 2021 ; Phu et al., 2022).
statement: 低氧可能会抑制生长。
text_zh: 低氧可能会抑制生长。
text_en: Hypoxia may inhibit growth.

quote: In addition, when the temperature was set to 30 °C, the growth rate under hyperoxia conditions was higher than that of mesoxia and hypoxic conditions, suggesting that hyperoxia may protect the crucian carp from the adverse effects of high temperature.
statement: 当温度设定为30°C时，高氧条件下的生长速率高于中氧和低氧条件，表明高氧可能保护鲫鱼免受高温的不利影响。
text_zh: 当温度设定为30°C时，高氧条件下的生长速率高于中氧和低氧条件，表明高氧可能保护鲫鱼免受高温的不利影响。
text_en: When the temperature was set at 30°C, the growth rate under high-oxygen conditions was higher than that under medium- and low-oxygen conditions, indicating that high oxygen may protect crucian carp from the adverse effects of high temperature.

quote: Crucian carp had better growth performance under hyperoxia (9.3 mgL −1) than under medium oxygen (5.4 mgL −1) or hypoxic (2.1 mgL −1) conditions.
statement: 鲫鱼在高氧（9.3 mg/L）条件下的生长性能优于中氧（5.4 mg/L）或低氧（2.1 mg/L）条件。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在高氧（9.3 mg/L）条件下的生长性能优于中氧（5.4 mg/L）或低氧（2.1 mg/L）条件。
text_en: The growth performance of crucian carp under high oxygen conditions (9.3 mg/L) was better than under medium oxygen (5.4 mg/L) or low oxygen (2.1 mg/L) conditions.

quote: Figure 4A shows that with the increase of oxygen concentration, glucose levels increased significantly under the three temperature conditions.
statement: 在三种温度条件下，随着氧气浓度的增加，血糖水平显著升高。
text_zh: 在三种温度条件下，随着氧气浓度的增加，血糖水平显著升高。
text_en: Under three temperature conditions, blood glucose levels increased significantly with increasing oxygen concentration.

quote: At the same oxygen concentration, the glucose level of the crucian carp increased and then decreased with the increase of temperature, reaching the highest levels at 24 °C (P
statement: 在相同氧气浓度下，鲫鱼血糖水平随温度升高先升后降，在24°C时达到最高。
text_zh: 在相同氧气浓度下，鲫鱼血糖水平随温度升高先升后降，在24°C时达到最高。
text_en: At the same oxygen concentration, blood glucose levels in crucian carp first increase and then decrease with rising temperature, reaching a maximum at 24°C.

quote: The total protein content under hypoxic conditions was lower than that under medium oxygen and hyperoxia conditions (P Fig. 4C .
statement: 低氧条件下的总蛋白含量低于中氧和高氧条件。
text_zh: 低氧条件下的总蛋白含量低于中氧和高氧条件。
text_en: Total protein content under hypoxic conditions was lower than under mesoxic and hyperoxic conditions.

quote: At a static temperature, an increased oxygen concentration caused the relative growth rate of Aeromonas to decrease.
statement: 在恒定温度下，氧气浓度的增加导致气单胞菌的相对生长率下降。
text_zh: 在恒定温度下，氧气浓度的增加导致气单胞菌的相对生长率下降。
text_en: At constant temperature, an increase in oxygen concentration led to a decrease in the relative growth rate of Aeromonas.

quote: When the amount of oxygen increased, the respiration and metabolic rate of the crucian carp increased and the immune system of the fish worked more efficiently, so that the antibacterial ability was enhanced.
statement: 当氧气量增加时，鲫鱼的呼吸和代谢率增加，鱼类的免疫系统工作效率更高，从而增强了抗菌能力。
text_zh: 当氧气量增加时，鲫鱼的呼吸和代谢率增加，鱼类的免疫系统工作效率更高，从而增强了抗菌能力。
text_en: When oxygen levels increase, the respiration and metabolic rates of crucian carp increase, the efficiency of the fish's immune system improves, thereby enhancing antibacterial capacity.

quote: It is well documented that Al-toxicity in various aquatic biota depends on changes in water physico-chemical conditions, rather than the presence or the concentration of a certain aluminium species
statement: 已有充分文献证明，各种水生生物的铝毒性取决于水体理化条件的变化，而非特定铝形态的存在或浓度。
text_zh: 已有充分文献证明，各种水生生物的铝毒性取决于水体理化条件的变化，而非特定铝形态的存在或浓度。
text_en: Sufficient literature has demonstrated that the aluminum toxicity of various aquatic organisms depends on changes in the physicochemical conditions of the water body, rather than the presence or concentration of specific aluminum forms.

quote: When Al-solubility decreases as pH is elevated in an acidic water body, the toxicity to fish increases because aluminium starts to polymerise, and subsequently accumulates on the gill surface
statement: 在酸性水体中，随着pH升高导致铝溶解度降低时，铝开始聚合并积累在鱼鳃表面，从而增加对鱼的毒性。
text_zh: 在酸性水体中，随着pH升高导致铝溶解度降低时，铝开始聚合并积累在鱼鳃表面，从而增加对鱼的毒性。
text_en: In acidic water bodies, as pH increases leading to decreased aluminum solubility, aluminum begins to aggregate and accumulate on the surface of fish gills, thereby increasing toxicity to fish.

quote: Hematocrit (HCT), mean hemoglobin content (MCH), and hemoglobin (HGB) were detected with a BM830 automatic hematology analyzer.
statement: 血细胞比容（HCT）、平均血红蛋白含量（MCH）和血红蛋白（HGB）使用BM830自动血液分析仪进行检测。
text_zh: 血细胞比容（HCT）、平均血红蛋白含量（MCH）和血红蛋白（HGB）使用BM830自动血液分析仪进行检测。
text_en: Hematocrit (HCT), mean corpuscular hemoglobin (MCH), and hemoglobin (HGB) were detected using the BM830 automatic blood analyzer.

quote: The results show an increased gill surface area in Al-exposed fish, while the critical O 2 -tension did not change.
statement: 暴露于铝的鲫鱼鳃表面积增加，但临界氧分压没有变化。
text_zh: 暴露于铝的鲫鱼鳃表面积增加，但临界氧分压没有变化。
text_en: Gill surface area increased in crucian carp exposed to aluminum, but critical oxygen pressure did not change.
outcome: 呼吸生理指标（鳃表面积、临界氧分压）

quote: The normoxic O 2 -consumption was lower in Al-exposed fish and might be due to a reduced metabolic rate.
statement: 暴露于铝的鲫鱼常氧耗氧量较低，这可能归因于代谢率降低。
text_zh: 暴露于铝的鲫鱼常氧耗氧量较低，这可能归因于代谢率降低。
text_en: Normoxic oxygen consumption of crucian carp exposed to aluminum is lower, which may be attributed to a reduced metabolic rate.

quote: The results suggest that crucian carp exposed to aluminium do not become hypoxic, since haematocrit, plasma lactate and blood ethanol did not differ from that of control fish after 14 days of exposure.
statement: 结果表明暴露于铝的鲫鱼不会缺氧，因为暴露14天后其血细胞比容、血浆乳酸和血液乙醇含量与对照组鱼无差异。
text_zh: 结果表明暴露于铝的鲫鱼不会缺氧，因为暴露14天后其血细胞比容、血浆乳酸和血液乙醇含量与对照组鱼无差异。
text_en: The results showed that crucian carp exposed to aluminum did not experience hypoxia, as their hematocrit, plasma lactate, and blood ethanol levels after 14 days of exposure were not significantly different from those of the control fish.
outcome: 缺氧状态及应激指标（血细胞比容、乳酸、乙醇）

quote: We also observed an initial loss of plasma chloride and sodium, followed by a stabilisation of these ions at a lower level than in control fish.
statement: 观察到血浆氯和钠最初流失，随后这些离子稳定在低于对照组的水平。
text_zh: 观察到血浆氯和钠最初流失，随后这些离子稳定在低于对照组的水平。
text_en: Plasma chloride and sodium were observed to be initially lost, after which these ions stabilized at levels lower than those of the control group.
outcome: 离子调节与渗透压平衡

quote: Fish can be subjected to a certain degree of oxidative damage by hypoxia, which impacts growth and serum biochemical indicators, subsequently affecting the metabolism and immune system of the fish (Borowiec & Scott, 2021a).
statement: 缺氧会导致鱼类遭受一定程度的氧化损伤，进而影响其代谢和免疫系统。
text_zh: 缺氧会导致鱼类遭受一定程度的氧化损伤，进而影响其代谢和免疫系统。
text_en: Hypoxia causes a certain degree of oxidative damage in fish, which in turn affects their metabolism and immune system.

quote: There is a negative correlation between the temperature of the water and the oxygen content (Jiang et al., 2021b) and some fish may exhibit agitation or avoidance behavior until the water temperature becomes tolerable.
statement: 水温与溶氧量呈负相关，部分鱼类在水温变得可耐受之前会表现出焦躁或回避行为。
text_zh: 水温与溶氧量呈负相关，部分鱼类在水温变得可耐受之前会表现出焦躁或回避行为。
text_en: Water temperature and dissolved oxygen are negatively correlated; some fish exhibit agitation or avoidance behavior before the water temperature becomes tolerable.

quote: The functional activities of the organs and tissues in the fish are altered with the temperature variations so that the fish body can maintain a balanced state as much as possible under higher temperatures (Kochhann et al., 2021).
statement: 随着温度变化，鱼类器官和组织的功能活动会发生改变，以便在较高温度下尽可能维持身体平衡状态。
text_zh: 随着温度变化，鱼类器官和组织的功能活动会发生改变，以便在较高温度下尽可能维持身体平衡状态。
text_en: As temperature changes, the functional activities of fish organs and tissues change in order to maintain body balance as much as possible at higher temperatures.

quote: Under hypoxic conditions, fish may move to an environment with sufficient oxygen.
statement: 在低氧条件下，鱼类可能会移动到氧气充足的环境中。
text_zh: 在低氧条件下，鱼类可能会移动到氧气充足的环境中。
text_en: Under low oxygen conditions, fish may move to environments with sufficient oxygen.

quote: The metabolic rate of fish increases with higher temperatures (Zhao et al., 2021), and the growth rate of fish can be reduced by low oxygen conditions (McNicholl et al., 2021).
statement: 鱼类的代谢率随温度升高而增加，且低氧条件会降低鱼类的生长率。
text_zh: 鱼类的代谢率随温度升高而增加，且低氧条件会降低鱼类的生长率。
text_en: The metabolic rate of fish increases with rising temperature, and hypoxic conditions reduce the growth rate of fish.

quote: Studies have also shown that hyperoxia conditions can alleviate the heat stress response of fish to a certain extent.
statement: 研究还表明，高氧条件可以在一定程度上缓解鱼类的热应激反应。
text_zh: 研究还表明，高氧条件可以在一定程度上缓解鱼类的热应激反应。
text_en: The study also showed that hyperoxia conditions can alleviate the heat stress response of fish to a certain extent.

quote: Substantial efforts were made to minimize the amount of fish used in the experiments, and to minimize possible suffering during exposures, and to ensure humane endpoint for fish that were sacrificed for sampling.
statement: The study implemented measures to minimize the number of fish used, reduce suffering during exposure, and ensure humane endpoints for sacrificed fish.
text_en: The study implemented measures to minimize the number of fish used, reduce suffering during exposure, and ensure humane endpoints for sacrificed fish.

quote: Two test media, with a pH of 5.8, were prepared by the addition of various stock solutions to the fish-holding department water: an acidic Al-poor water, by adding a HNO 3 stock solution (pH 2.0), and an acidic Al-rich water, by adding a Al(NO 3) 3 x 9H 2 O plus HNO 3 stock solution (pH 2.0).
statement: Acidic test media with pH 5.8 were created by adding nitric acid or aluminum nitrate plus nitric acid stock solutions to department water.
text_en: Acidic test media with pH 5.8 were created by adding nitric acid or aluminum nitrate plus nitric acid stock solutions to department water.

quote: The electrical conductivity of all waters was stable, between 23.7 and 29.6 μS/cm throughout both experiments (Table 2).
statement: 所有实验用水的电导率在两次实验中保持稳定，介于23.7至29.6 μS/cm之间。
text_zh: 所有实验用水的电导率在两次实验中保持稳定，介于23.7至29.6 μS/cm之间。
text_en: The conductivity of all experimental water remained stable across the two experiments, ranging between 23.7 and 29.6 μS/cm.

quote: High temperature and hypoxia stress may reduce the antibacterial properties of crucian carp, and various physiological indicators may become disordered as a result.
statement: 高温和缺氧胁迫可能会降低鲫鱼的抗菌特性，并导致各种生理指标紊乱。
text_zh: 高温和缺氧胁迫可能会降低鲫鱼的抗菌特性，并导致各种生理指标紊乱。
text_en: High temperature and hypoxia stress may reduce the antibacterial properties of crucian carp and lead to disturbances in various physiological indicators.

quote: However, these adverse effects can be mitigated to some extent by increasing the oxygen concentration.
statement: 通过增加氧气浓度可以在一定程度上减轻这些不利影响。
text_zh: 通过增加氧气浓度可以在一定程度上减轻这些不利影响。
text_en: Increasing oxygen concentration can mitigate these adverse effects to some extent.

quote: Therefore, according to the changing trends of various parameters in the nine treatment groups, the optimal growth environment for crucian carp was the H24 treatment.
statement: 根据九个处理组中各种参数的变化趋势，鲫鱼的最佳生长环境是H24处理组。
text_zh: 根据九个处理组中各种参数的变化趋势，鲫鱼的最佳生长环境是H24处理组。
text_en: Based on the trends of various parameters across nine treatment groups, the optimal growth environment for crucian carp is the H24 treatment group.

quote: These results indicate that under high oxygen conditions, the water temperature was best kept at 24 °C.
statement: 结果表明，在高氧条件下，水温最好保持在24°C。
text_zh: 结果表明，在高氧条件下，水温最好保持在24°C。
text_en: The results indicate that under high-oxygen conditions, the water temperature should best be maintained at 24°C.

quote: The primary effect of Al-polymerisation and precipitation or accumulation on the fish gill surface has been suggested to be hypoxia
statement: 铝聚合、沉淀或积累在鱼鳃表面的主要影响被认为是缺氧。
text_zh: 铝聚合、沉淀或积累在鱼鳃表面的主要影响被认为是缺氧。
text_en: The main effect of aluminum polymerization, precipitation, or accumulation on the fish gill surface is considered to be hypoxia.

quote: Moreover, several studies have shown that exposure to dissolved aluminium disrupts ion regulation as well as respiration in fish [ 10 , 22 – 25 ].
statement: 多项研究表明，暴露于溶解铝会破坏鱼类的离子调节和呼吸功能。
text_zh: 多项研究表明，暴露于溶解铝会破坏鱼类的离子调节和呼吸功能。
text_en: Multiple studies have shown that exposure to dissolved aluminum disrupts ion regulation and respiratory function in fish.

quote: The fish were fed once a day for at least 2 weeks prior to the experiments.
statement: 实验前至少两周，鱼每天喂食一次。
text_zh: 实验前至少两周，鱼每天喂食一次。
text_en: At least two weeks before the experiment, fish were fed once daily.

quote: Two days before, and during the experiments, the fish were not fed in order to avoid the influence of food on blood parameters.
statement: 实验前两天及实验期间不喂食，以避免食物对血液参数的影响。
text_zh: 实验前两天及实验期间不喂食，以避免食物对血液参数的影响。
text_en: No feeding was provided for two days before the experiment and during the experiment, to avoid the influence of food on blood parameters.

quote: All animal husbandry conditions and experimental protocols, including sampling procedures and experimental manipulations, reported in this paper were in strict accordance to the guidelines of the Norwegian Animal Research Authority, and approved by the head of the fish holding department at the University of Oslo.
statement: 所有动物饲养条件和实验方案均严格遵守挪威动物研究管理局的指南，并得到奥斯陆大学鱼类饲养部门负责人的批准。
text_zh: 所有动物饲养条件和实验方案均严格遵守挪威动物研究管理局的指南，并得到奥斯陆大学鱼类饲养部门负责人的批准。
text_en: All animal husbandry conditions and experimental protocols strictly followed the guidelines of the Norwegian Animal Research Authority and were approved by the head of the fish husbandry department at the University of Oslo.

quote: The fish were sheltered from external stress by providing the channels with opaque PVC-covers.
statement: 通过提供不透明的PVC盖子来遮蔽鱼群，以减少外部应激。
text_zh: 通过提供不透明的PVC盖子来遮蔽鱼群，以减少外部应激。
text_en: Shading the fish group by providing opaque PVC covers to reduce external stress.

quote: euthanized with a firm blow to the head, to avoid any effects of anaesthetic drugs and time until fully anaesthetised on the physiological parameters.
statement: 使用头部重击进行安乐死，以避免麻醉药物及其起效时间对生理参数的影响。
text_zh: 使用头部重击进行安乐死，以避免麻醉药物及其起效时间对生理参数的影响。
text_en: Euthanasia by percussive blow to the head was used to avoid the effects of anesthetic agents and their onset time on physiological parameters.

quote: When the temperature and oxygen content change, excessive oxygen free radicals are generated in the environment, and macromolecules such as proteins and lipids in the fish are destroyed, thereby affecting their health (Liu et al., 2021 ; Aswathy et al., 2021 ; Baldissera et al., 2020).
statement: 当温度和氧气含量变化时，环境中会产生过量的氧自由基，破坏鱼类体内的蛋白质和脂质等大分子，从而影响其健康。
text_zh: 当温度和氧气含量变化时，环境中会产生过量的氧自由基，破坏鱼类体内的蛋白质和脂质等大分子，从而影响其健康。
text_en: When temperature and oxygen content change, excess oxygen free radicals are produced in the environment, damaging macromolecules such as proteins and lipids in fish, thereby affecting their health.

quote: However, this oxygen radical can be eliminated by the antioxidant defense system of fish, including CAT, GPx, and SOD (Baldissera et al., 2019).
statement: 然而，这种氧自由基可以被鱼类的抗氧化防御系统消除，包括过氧化氢酶(CAT)、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPx)和超氧化物歧化酶(SOD)。
text_zh: 然而，这种氧自由基可以被鱼类的抗氧化防御系统消除，包括过氧化氢酶(CAT)、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPx)和超氧化物歧化酶(SOD)。
text_en: However, this oxygen free radical can be eliminated by the antioxidant defense system of fish, including catalase (CAT), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), and superoxide dismutase (SOD).

quote: Under anoxic conditions, the activities of CAT and GPx in the crucian carp were slightly weakened at 18 °C–30 °C, the SOD activity was slightly increased at 24 °C, and decreased slightly at 30 °C.
statement: 在缺氧条件下，18°C至30°C时鲫鱼体内CAT和GPx的活性略有减弱，24°C时SOD活性略有增加，30°C时略有下降。
text_zh: 在缺氧条件下，18°C至30°C时鲫鱼体内CAT和GPx的活性略有减弱，24°C时SOD活性略有增加，30°C时略有下降。
text_en: Under hypoxic conditions, the activities of CAT and GPx in crucian carp slightly decreased at 18°C to 30°C; SOD activity slightly increased at 24°C and slightly decreased at 30°C.

quote: This means that the crucian carp was in relatively good condition.
statement: 这意味着鲫鱼处于相对良好的状态。
text_zh: 这意味着鲫鱼处于相对良好的状态。
text_en: This means that crucian carp are in a relatively good condition.

quote: At the same temperature, the activities of the three antioxidant enzymes were the highest in hyperoxia, followed by mesoxia, and lowest in hypoxia.
statement: 在相同温度下，三种抗氧化酶的活性在高氧条件下最高，其次是中氧，在低氧条件下最低。
text_zh: 在相同温度下，三种抗氧化酶的活性在高氧条件下最高，其次是中氧，在低氧条件下最低。
text_en: At the same temperature, the activity of three antioxidant enzymes was highest under high oxygen conditions, followed by medium oxygen, and lowest under low oxygen conditions.

quote: However, the enzyme activity is extremely low under hypoxic conditions, and the antioxidant capacity is the weakest (Yang et al., 2015).
statement: 在低氧条件下，酶活性极低，抗氧化能力最弱。
text_zh: 在低氧条件下，酶活性极低，抗氧化能力最弱。
text_en: Under hypoxic conditions, enzyme activity is extremely low and antioxidant capacity is the weakest.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化能力

quote: The heat stress experienced by crucian carp may also improve under hypoxic conditions.
statement: 鲫鱼在低氧条件下经历的热应激可能得到改善。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在低氧条件下经历的热应激可能得到改善。
text_en: Heat stress experienced by crucian carp under hypoxic conditions may be improved.

quote: Glucose levels in fish are affected by temperature and oxygen levels (da Costa Barroso, Almeida-Val & Luis Val, 2020).
statement: 鱼类血糖水平受温度和氧气水平的影响。
text_zh: 鱼类血糖水平受温度和氧气水平的影响。
text_en: Fish blood glucose levels are affected by temperature and oxygen levels.

quote: Low glucose concentrations can affect the growth rate and appetite of fish (Zhang et al., 2022).
statement: 低血糖浓度会影响鱼类的生长速度和食欲。
text_zh: 低血糖浓度会影响鱼类的生长速度和食欲。
text_en: Low blood glucose concentrations affect the growth rate and appetite of fish.

quote: The results revealed that the L27-treated crucian carp had the lowest glucose concentrations, which resulted in decreased appetite and slower growth.
statement: L27处理的鲫鱼血糖浓度最低，导致食欲下降和生长减慢。
text_zh: L27处理的鲫鱼血糖浓度最低，导致食欲下降和生长减慢。
text_en: The L27 treatment resulted in the lowest blood glucose concentration in crucian carp, leading to decreased appetite and slowed growth.

quote: Under the same oxygen concentrations, the total protein activity increased at 24 °C and 30 °C, indicating that the body tissue of crucian carp may have been damaged when the water temperature increased (Wang et al., 2021b).
statement: 在相同溶氧浓度下，24°C和30°C时总蛋白活性增加，表明水温升高可能导致鲫鱼身体组织受损。
text_zh: 在相同溶氧浓度下，24°C和30°C时总蛋白活性增加，表明水温升高可能导致鲫鱼身体组织受损。
text_en: At the same dissolved oxygen concentration, total protein activity increased at 24°C and 30°C, indicating that rising water temperature may cause damage to the body tissues of crucian carp.

quote: In addition, the total protein content was lower under hypoxic conditions than under meso- and hyperoxia conditions.
statement: 此外，低氧条件下的总蛋白含量低于中氧和高氧条件。
text_zh: 此外，低氧条件下的总蛋白含量低于中氧和高氧条件。
text_en: In addition, the total protein content under hypoxic conditions was lower than that under mesic and hyperoxic conditions.

quote: Therefore, high concentration of oxygen may reduce the degree of tissue damage and accelerate tissue recovery in crucian carp.
statement: 因此，高浓度氧气可能减轻鲫鱼的组织损伤程度并加速组织恢复。
text_zh: 因此，高浓度氧气可能减轻鲫鱼的组织损伤程度并加速组织恢复。
text_en: Therefore, high oxygen concentration may reduce the extent of tissue damage in crucian carp and accelerate tissue recovery.

quote: Compared with 18 °C and 24 °C, the survival rate of crucian carp at 30 °C was the lowest, indicating that crucian carp needs to consume a lot of triglycerides under high temperature conditions.
statement: 与18°C和24°C相比，30°C时鲫鱼的存活率最低，表明在高温条件下鲫鱼需要消耗大量甘油三酯。
text_zh: 与18°C和24°C相比，30°C时鲫鱼的存活率最低，表明在高温条件下鲫鱼需要消耗大量甘油三酯。
text_en: Compared to 18°C and 24°C, the survival rate of crucian carp was lowest at 30°C, indicating that crucian carp need to consume large amounts of triglycerides under high-temperature conditions.

quote: To explore the antioxidant capacity of the crucian carp, the activities of three antioxidant enzymes were measured in the serum sampled from nine treatment groups.
statement: 为了探究鲫鱼的抗氧化能力，从九个处理组采集的血清中测量了三种抗氧化酶的活性。
text_zh: 为了探究鲫鱼的抗氧化能力，从九个处理组采集的血清中测量了三种抗氧化酶的活性。
text_en: To investigate the antioxidant capacity of crucian carp, the activities of three antioxidant enzymes were measured in serum collected from nine treatment groups.

quote: As shown in Figs. 3A – 3C , the activities of CAT, GPx, and SOD in the serum of the crucian carp were significantly enhanced with the increase of oxygen concentration (P
statement: 如图3A-3C所示，随着氧气浓度的增加，鲫鱼血清中CAT、GPx和SOD的活性显著增强。
text_zh: 如图3A-3C所示，随着氧气浓度的增加，鲫鱼血清中CAT、GPx和SOD的活性显著增强。
text_en: As shown in Figures 3A-3C, with increasing oxygen concentration, the activities of CAT, GPx and SOD in the serum of crucian carp significantly increased.

quote: Figure 3B shows that under hypoxia, the serum GPx activity of the crucian carp under 24 °C and 30 °C decreased by 4.76% and 21.43%, respectively, compared with 18 °C.
statement: 图3B显示，在缺氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C和30°C下鲫鱼血清GPx活性分别降低了4.76%和21.43%。
text_zh: 图3B显示，在缺氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C和30°C下鲫鱼血清GPx活性分别降低了4.76%和21.43%。
text_en: Figure 3B shows that under hypoxic conditions, serum GPx activity in crucian carp decreased by 4.76% and 21.43% at 24°C and 30°C, respectively, compared to 18°C.

quote: Under medium oxygen conditions, the serum GPx activity of the crucian carp at 24 °C and 30 °C increased by 11.85% and 24.44%, respectively, compared with 18 °C.
statement: 在中氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C和30°C下鲫鱼血清GPx活性分别增加了11.85%和24.44%。
text_zh: 在中氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C和30°C下鲫鱼血清GPx活性分别增加了11.85%和24.44%。
text_en: Under moderate oxygen conditions, serum GPx activity in crucian carp increased by 11.85% and 24.44% at 24°C and 30°C, respectively, compared to 18°C.

quote: Under high oxygen conditions, the serum GPx activity at 24 °C and 30 °C increased by 16.46% and 25.32%, respectively, compared with 18 °C.
statement: 在高氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C和30°C下血清GPx活性分别增加了16.46%和25.32%。
text_zh: 在高氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C和30°C下血清GPx活性分别增加了16.46%和25.32%。
text_en: Under high-oxygen conditions, serum GPx activity increased by 16.46% and 25.32% at 24°C and 30°C, respectively, compared to 18°C.

quote: Figure 3C shows that under hypoxic condition, the serum SOD activity of the crucian carp increased by 11.86% and decreased by 9.32% at 24 °C and 30 °C, compared with 18 °C.
statement: 图3C显示，在缺氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C时鲫鱼血清SOD活性增加了11.86%，而30°C时降低了9.32%。
text_zh: 图3C显示，在缺氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C时鲫鱼血清SOD活性增加了11.86%，而30°C时降低了9.32%。
text_en: Figure 3C shows that under hypoxic conditions, compared to 18°C, serum SOD activity in crucian carp increased by 11.86% at 24°C and decreased by 9.32% at 30°C.

quote: Under medium oxygen conditions, the serum SOD activity increased by 16.32% and 10.10% at 24 °C and 30 °C, compared with 18 °C.
statement: 在中氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C和30°C时血清SOD活性分别增加了16.32%和10.10%。
text_zh: 在中氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C和30°C时血清SOD活性分别增加了16.32%和10.10%。
text_en: Under moderate oxygen conditions, serum SOD activity increased by 16.32% and 10.10% at 24°C and 30°C, respectively, compared to 18°C.

quote: Under high oxygen conditions, the SOD activity of the serum increased by 5.37% and decreased by 4.19% at 24 °C and 30 °C, compared with 18 °C.
statement: 在高氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C时血清SOD活性增加了5.37%，而30°C时降低了4.19%。
text_zh: 在高氧条件下，与18°C相比，24°C时血清SOD活性增加了5.37%，而30°C时降低了4.19%。
text_en: Under hyperoxic conditions, compared to 18°C, serum SOD activity increased by 5.37% at 24°C and decreased by 4.19% at 30°C.

quote: The two-way ANOVA was used to detect the changes of serum antioxidant enzyme activities of crucian carp at different temperatures and oxygen levels (n = 9).
statement: 使用双因素方差分析检测不同温度和氧气水平下鲫鱼血清抗氧化酶活性的变化（n=9）。
text_zh: 使用双因素方差分析检测不同温度和氧气水平下鲫鱼血清抗氧化酶活性的变化（n=9）。
text_en: Two-way ANOVA was used to detect changes in serum antioxidant enzyme activity of crucian carp under different temperature and oxygen levels (n=9).

quote: At the same temperature, there was less of a reduction of triglycerides under hyperoxia conditions than that under mesoxia and hypoxia conditions.
statement: 在相同温度下，高氧条件下的甘油三酯减少量少于中氧和低氧条件。
text_zh: 在相同温度下，高氧条件下的甘油三酯减少量少于中氧和低氧条件。
text_en: At the same temperature, the reduction in triglycerides under high-oxygen conditions was less than that under medium-oxygen and low-oxygen conditions.
outcome: 能量代谢（甘油三酯水平）

quote: This suggests that hyperoxia helps to alleviate the high temperature-induced triglyceride consumption in crucian carp.
statement: 这表明高氧有助于缓解高温诱导的鲫鱼甘油三酯消耗。
text_zh: 这表明高氧有助于缓解高温诱导的鲫鱼甘油三酯消耗。
text_en: This indicates that high oxygen helps alleviate the heat-induced triglyceride consumption in crucian carp.

quote: At the same temperature, the hematocrit under hypoxic conditions was higher than that under mesoxia and hyperoxia conditions (Gomez Isaza, Cramp & Franklin, 2021).
statement: 在相同温度下，低氧条件下的红细胞压积高于中氧和高氧条件。
text_zh: 在相同温度下，低氧条件下的红细胞压积高于中氧和高氧条件。
text_en: At the same temperature, hematocrit under hypoxic conditions is higher than under moderate and high oxygen conditions.
outcome: 血液生理指标（红细胞压积）

quote: Low oxygen concentrations cause the hemoglobin and oxygen transport capacity in the body to increase and the body is able to maintain normal physiological functions (Borowiec & Scott, 2021b).
statement: 低氧浓度导致体内血红蛋白和氧气运输能力增加，使身体能够维持正常的生理功能。
text_zh: 低氧浓度导致体内血红蛋白和氧气运输能力增加，使身体能够维持正常的生理功能。
text_en: Low oxygen concentration leads to increased hemoglobin and oxygen transport capacity in the body, enabling the body to maintain normal physiological functions.

quote: When the oxygen concentration is too high, although the oxygen carrying capacity is strong, the blood viscosity increases, the blood flow resistance increases, and the hematocrit decreases.
statement: 当氧浓度过高时，虽然携氧能力强，但血液粘度增加，血流阻力增加，红细胞压积降低。
text_zh: 当氧浓度过高时，虽然携氧能力强，但血液粘度增加，血流阻力增加，红细胞压积降低。
text_en: When oxygen concentration is too high, although the oxygen-carrying capacity is strong, blood viscosity increases, blood flow resistance increases, and hematocrit decreases.
outcome: 血液流变学/心血管负担

quote: The water chemistry analyses show that the experimental fish was exposed to an ongoing polymerisation of aluminium in the trials with acidic Al-rich water.
statement: 水化学分析表明，在酸性富铝水的试验中，实验鱼暴露于正在进行的铝聚合过程中。
text_zh: 水化学分析表明，在酸性富铝水的试验中，实验鱼暴露于正在进行的铝聚合过程中。
text_en: Water chemistry analysis indicated that in the acidic aluminum-rich water trials, experimental fish were exposed to ongoing aluminum polymerization.

quote: This is supported by the observed decrease in the total amount of dissolved aluminium (Alr-fraction) as the water moved through the experimental set-up.
statement: 随着水流经实验装置，溶解铝总量（Alr部分）的减少支持了上述观察结果。
text_zh: 随着水流经实验装置，溶解铝总量（Alr部分）的减少支持了上述观察结果。
text_en: The reduction in total dissolved aluminum (Alr fraction) as water flowed through the experimental apparatus supports the above observations.

quote: Therefore, the larger concentration of Alo is most probably caused by Al-polymerisation.
statement: 因此，较高浓度的Alo最可能是由铝聚合引起的。
text_zh: 因此，较高浓度的Alo最可能是由铝聚合引起的。
text_en: Therefore, the higher concentration of Alo is most likely caused by aluminum polymerization.

quote: There was no mortality observed among fish exposed to aluminium during the experimental periods.
statement: 在实验期间，暴露于铝的鱼没有观察到死亡率。
text_zh: 在实验期间，暴露于铝的鱼没有观察到死亡率。
text_en: During the experiment, no mortality was observed in fish exposed to aluminum.

quote: Subsequently, blood samples were collected from the dorsal artery, and transferred to 50 μl blood caps.
statement: 从背动脉采集血液样本并转移至微量离心管中。
text_zh: 从背动脉采集血液样本并转移至微量离心管中。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the dorsal aorta and transferred into microcentrifuge tubes.

quote: In the respiratory experiment the oxygen consumption V O2 was monitored by means of closed respirometry, after a previously described protocol [ 27 – 28 ], and the critical oxygen tension [O2] crit was determined as earlier described [ 29 ].
statement: 通过封闭式呼吸测量法监测耗氧量，并确定临界氧张力。
text_zh: 通过封闭式呼吸测量法监测耗氧量，并确定临界氧张力。
text_en: Oxygen consumption was monitored using closed respirometry, and the critical oxygen tension was determined.

quote: Each individual fish were exposed for 6 days to the water in question, before it was transferred to the respirometer.
statement: 每条鱼在转入呼吸计之前，先暴露于待测水体中6天。
text_zh: 每条鱼在转入呼吸计之前，先暴露于待测水体中6天。
text_en: Each fish was exposed to the test water for 6 days before being transferred into the respirometer.

quote: The fish was kept in the respirometer with a continuous flow-through (1.5 l/min) for 15 hours, before the respirometer was closed and the measurements of oxygen uptake started.
statement: 鱼在呼吸计中以连续流（1.5升/分钟）保持15小时，随后关闭呼吸计开始测量摄氧量。
text_zh: 鱼在呼吸计中以连续流（1.5升/分钟）保持15小时，随后关闭呼吸计开始测量摄氧量。
text_en: Fish were kept in a respirometer with continuous flow (1.5 L/min) for 15 hours, after which the respirometer was closed to begin measuring oxygen consumption.

quote: In the trials with untreated department water the pH was stable, and remained at 6.5 throughout the experimental periods (Table 2 and S1 Table).
statement: 在未处理的部门用水试验中，pH值稳定，在整个实验期间保持在6.5。
text_zh: 在未处理的部门用水试验中，pH值稳定，在整个实验期间保持在6.5。
text_en: In the untreated departmental water test, pH was stable and remained at 6.5 throughout the experiment.

quote: In the trials with the acidic waters pH varied between 5.7 and 5.8.
statement: 在酸性水试验中，pH值在5.7到5.8之间变化。
text_zh: 在酸性水试验中，pH值在5.7到5.8之间变化。
text_en: In the acidic water test, the pH varied between 5.7 and 5.8.

quote: our results showed that the area of the gill surface was increased as a consequence of enlarged lamellae in Al-exposed crucian carp compared to controls
statement: 暴露于铝的鲫鱼与对照组相比，由于鳃小片增大，其鳃表面积增加。
text_zh: 暴露于铝的鲫鱼与对照组相比，由于鳃小片增大，其鳃表面积增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group, crucian carp exposed to aluminum had an increased gill surface area due to enlarged lamellae.

quote: This might be one way in which crucian carp copes with the consequences of Al-induced hypoxia.
statement: 鳃表面积的增加可能是鲫鱼应对铝诱导缺氧后果的一种方式。
text_zh: 鳃表面积的增加可能是鲫鱼应对铝诱导缺氧后果的一种方式。
text_en: The increase in gill surface area may be one way for crucian carp to cope with the consequences of aluminum-induced hypoxia.

quote: Consequently, the absence of gill damage suggests that crucian carp, to some extent, has the ability to avoid the effects of Al-toxicity.
statement: 因此，缺乏鳃损伤表明鲫鱼在一定程度上具有避免铝毒性影响的能力。
text_zh: 因此，缺乏鳃损伤表明鲫鱼在一定程度上具有避免铝毒性影响的能力。
text_en: Therefore, the lack of gill damage indicates that crucian carp have a certain ability to avoid the effects of aluminum toxicity.

quote: Al-exposed crucian carp showed a significantly lower O 2 -uptake compared to fish exposed to the acidic Al-poor water.
statement: 与暴露于酸性低铝水中的鱼相比，暴露于铝的鲫鱼表现出显著较低的氧气摄取量。
text_zh: 与暴露于酸性低铝水中的鱼相比，暴露于铝的鲫鱼表现出显著较低的氧气摄取量。
text_en: Compared to fish exposed to acidic low-aluminum water, crucian carp exposed to aluminum showed significantly lower oxygen uptake.

quote: The gills from fish exposed to the acidic Al-poor water showed a similar structural morphology as the gills from fish in the untreated water.
statement: 暴露于酸性低铝水中的鱼鳃显示出与未处理水中鱼鳃相似的结构形态。
text_zh: 暴露于酸性低铝水中的鱼鳃显示出与未处理水中鱼鳃相似的结构形态。
text_en: Fish gills exposed to acidic low-aluminum water showed structural morphology similar to that of fish gills in untreated water.

quote: Fish exposed to acidic Al-rich water showed a normoxic O 2 -consuption at 30 ± 4 mg/kg·h O 2 (n = 6). In comparison, the normoxic O 2 -consuption in fish exposed to untreated and acidic Al-poor water was 54 ± 15 and 63 ± 11 mg/kg·h O 2 (n = 6) respectively (Table 4).
statement: 暴露于酸性高铝水中的鱼的常氧耗氧量为30±4 mg/kg·h，而暴露于未处理水和酸性低铝水中的鱼的常氧耗氧量分别为54±15和63±11 mg/kg·h。
text_zh: 暴露于酸性高铝水中的鱼的常氧耗氧量为30±4 mg/kg·h，而暴露于未处理水和酸性低铝水中的鱼的常氧耗氧量分别为54±15和63±11 mg/kg·h。
text_en: The routine oxygen consumption of fish exposed to acidic high-aluminum water was 30±4 mg/kg·h, while that of fish exposed to untreated water and acidic low-aluminum water was 54±15 and 63±11 mg/kg·h, respectively.

quote: There were no significant differences between fish exposed to untreated water compared to fish from the acidic Al-poor water (F 1,10 = 0.208, p = 0.658), or compared to fish from the acidic Al-rich water (F 1,10 = 2.407, p = 0.151).
statement: 暴露于未处理水的鱼与暴露于酸性低铝水或酸性高铝水的鱼之间在耗氧量上没有显著差异。
text_zh: 暴露于未处理水的鱼与暴露于酸性低铝水或酸性高铝水的鱼之间在耗氧量上没有显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in oxygen consumption between fish exposed to untreated water and fish exposed to acidic low-aluminum or acidic high-aluminum water.

quote: However, there was a significant difference between fish exposed to the acidic Al-poor water compared to fish from acidic Al-rich water (F 1,10 = 8.380, p = 0.016).
statement: 暴露于酸性低铝水的鱼与暴露于酸性高铝水的鱼在耗氧量上存在显著差异。
text_zh: 暴露于酸性低铝水的鱼与暴露于酸性高铝水的鱼在耗氧量上存在显著差异。
text_en: There is a significant difference in oxygen consumption between fish exposed to acidic low-aluminum water and fish exposed to acidic high-aluminum water.

quote: Moreover, there were no significant differences in critical O 2 -tension between fish exposed to the different waters (F 1,10 0.150).
statement: 暴露于不同水质的鱼在临界氧张力方面没有显著差异。
text_zh: 暴露于不同水质的鱼在临界氧张力方面没有显著差异。
text_en: Fish exposed to different water qualities showed no significant difference in critical oxygen tension.

quote: At day 14, Al-exposed fish had higher MWC compared to the other two groups
statement: 在第14天，暴露于铝的鱼类的平均血细胞体积（MWC）高于其他两组。
text_zh: 在第14天，暴露于铝的鱼类的平均血细胞体积（MWC）高于其他两组。
text_en: On day 14, the mean corpuscular volume (MWC) of fish exposed to aluminum was higher than that of the other two groups.

quote: Plasma lactate did not change significantly in any of the trials (F 3,23 0.154) during the exposures, and remained between 0.5 ± 0.1 and 1.6 ± 0.6 mM (Fig 2E).
statement: 在暴露期间，所有试验中的血浆乳酸均未发生显著变化，并保持在0.5 ± 0.1至1.6 ± 0.6 mM之间。
text_zh: 在暴露期间，所有试验中的血浆乳酸均未发生显著变化，并保持在0.5 ± 0.1至1.6 ± 0.6 mM之间。
text_en: During the exposure period, plasma lactate did not change significantly in any of the trials and remained between 0.5 ± 0.1 and 1.6 ± 0.6 mM.

quote: Moreover, there were no significant differences in plasma lactate between any of the groups (F 2,11 > 3.525, p
statement: 此外，各组之间的血浆乳酸没有显著差异。
text_zh: 此外，各组之间的血浆乳酸没有显著差异。
text_en: In addition, there was no significant difference in plasma lactate among the groups.

quote: Blood ethanol in fish exposed to untreated and acidic Al-rich water did not change significantly (F 3,24 = 1.963, p = 0.151 and F 3,24 = 1.963, p = 0.151 respectively) during the trials
statement: 在试验期间，暴露于未处理水和酸性富铝水的鱼类血液乙醇浓度没有显著变化。
text_zh: 在试验期间，暴露于未处理水和酸性富铝水的鱼类血液乙醇浓度没有显著变化。
text_en: During the trial period, there was no significant change in blood ethanol concentrations of fish exposed to untreated water and acidic aluminum-rich water.

quote: However, there was a significant effect of duration of exposure in fish from the Al-poor water (F 3,23 = 4.726, p = 0.010), where blood ethanol increased significantly between day 2 (0.92 ± 0.05 mM) and 6 (1.16 ± 0.11 mM) (p = 0.038), and decreased between day 6 and 14 (0.76 ± 0.04 mM) (p = 0,011).
statement: 然而，对于来自贫铝水的鱼类，暴露持续时间有显著影响，其血液乙醇在第2天到第6天之间显著增加，并在第6天到第14天之间减少。
text_zh: 然而，对于来自贫铝水的鱼类，暴露持续时间有显著影响，其血液乙醇在第2天到第6天之间显著增加，并在第6天到第14天之间减少。
text_en: However, for fish from acidic aluminum-poor water, exposure duration had a significant effect; their blood ethanol increased significantly between day 2 and day 6, and decreased between day 6 and day 14.

quote: The gills from fish exposed to the acidic Al-rich water showed no sign of structural damage (Fig 3).
statement: 暴露于酸性富铝水的鱼鳃未显示结构损伤的迹象。
text_zh: 暴露于酸性富铝水的鱼鳃未显示结构损伤的迹象。
text_en: Fish gills exposed to acidic aluminum-rich water did not show signs of structural damage.

quote: However, the lamellar surface of the gills from fish exposed to the acidic Al-rich water was larger, with clearly visible secondary lamellae present, compared to fish exposed to untreated and acidic Al-poor water, where secondary lamellae were not clearly visible (Fig 3).
statement: 然而，与暴露于未处理水和酸性贫铝水的鱼类相比，暴露于酸性富铝水的鱼类鳃的小叶表面更大，且清晰可见次级小叶。
text_zh: 然而，与暴露于未处理水和酸性贫铝水的鱼类相比，暴露于酸性富铝水的鱼类鳃的小叶表面更大，且清晰可见次级小叶。
text_en: However, compared to fish exposed to untreated water and acidic low-aluminum water, fish exposed to acidic high-aluminum water had larger gill lamellar surface areas, with secondary lamellae clearly visible.

quote: During the physiological experiment the total aluminium concentration (Alr) in the Al-rich water was 929 ± 250 μg/l at the inlet, and 656 ± 136 μg/l at the outlet of the exposure channels.
statement: 在生理实验中，富铝水在暴露通道入口处的总铝浓度（Alr）为929 ± 250 μg/l，出口处为656 ± 136 μg/l。
text_zh: 在生理实验中，富铝水在暴露通道入口处的总铝浓度（Alr）为929 ± 250 μg/l，出口处为656 ± 136 μg/l。
text_en: In physiological experiments, the total aluminum concentration (Alr) of aluminum-enriched water was 929 ± 250 μg/l at the entrance of the exposure channel and 656 ± 136 μg/l at the exit.

quote: At the inlet approximately 43% of this amount was present as monomeric Al-species (Ala: 400 ± 41 μg/l), and approximately constituted 63% (Ala: 416 ± 56 μg/l) at the outlet (Table 3 and S2 Table).
statement: 入口处约43%的铝以单体铝形态存在（Ala: 400 ± 41 μg/l），出口处约占63%（Ala: 416 ± 56 μg/l）。
text_zh: 入口处约43%的铝以单体铝形态存在（Ala: 400 ± 41 μg/l），出口处约占63%（Ala: 416 ± 56 μg/l）。
text_en: About 43% of the aluminum at the inlet exists as monomeric aluminum (Ala: 400 ± 41 μg/l), and about 63% at the outlet (Ala: 416 ± 56 μg/l).

quote: The calculated inorganic monomeric Al-fraction (Ali) was 252 ± 50 μg/l (63% of the Ala-fraction) at the inlet, and 251 ± 78 μg/l (60% of the Ala-fraction) at the outlet of the exposure channels.
statement: 计算得出的无机单体铝分数（Ali）在入口处为252 ± 50 μg/l（占Ala分数的63%），在出口处为251 ± 78 μg/l（占Ala分数的60%）。
text_zh: 计算得出的无机单体铝分数（Ali）在入口处为252 ± 50 μg/l（占Ala分数的63%），在出口处为251 ± 78 μg/l（占Ala分数的60%）。
text_en: The calculated inorganic monomeric aluminum fraction (Ali) was 252 ± 50 μg/l at the inlet (63% of the Ala fraction) and 251 ± 78 μg/l at the outlet (60% of the Ala fraction).

quote: The Ala fraction varied between 16 and 23 μg/l, while the Ali fraction varied between 1 and 11 μg/l.
statement: 单体铝分数（Ala）在16至23 μg/l之间变化，而无机单体铝分数（Ali）在1至11 μg/l之间变化。
text_zh: 单体铝分数（Ala）在16至23 μg/l之间变化，而无机单体铝分数（Ali）在1至11 μg/l之间变化。
text_en: The monomeric aluminum fraction (Ala) varied between 16 and 23 μg/l, while the inorganic monomeric aluminum fraction (Ali) varied between 1 and 11 μg/l.

quote: During the respiratory experiment the Alr concentration in the Al-rich water was 878 ± 160 μg/l at the inlet, and 666 ± 89 μg/l at the outlet of the exposure channels.
statement: 在呼吸实验中，富铝水在暴露通道入口处的总铝浓度（Alr）为878 ± 160 μg/l，出口处为666 ± 89 μg/l。
text_zh: 在呼吸实验中，富铝水在暴露通道入口处的总铝浓度（Alr）为878 ± 160 μg/l，出口处为666 ± 89 μg/l。
text_en: In the respiration experiment, the total aluminum concentration (Alr) in aluminum-enriched water was 878 ± 160 μg/l at the entrance of the exposure channel and 666 ± 89 μg/l at the exit.

quote: At the inlet, approximately 77% of this amount was present as Ala (673 ± 223 μg/l), and approximately 70% (Ala: 469 ± 107 μg/l) at the outlet (Table 3 and S2 Table).
statement: 入口处约77%的铝以Ala形式存在（673 ± 223 μg/l），出口处约为70%（Ala: 469 ± 107 μg/l）。
text_en: 入口处约77%的铝以Ala形式存在（673 ± 223 μg/l），出口处约为70%（Ala: 469 ± 107 μg/l）。

quote: The calculated Ali-fraction was 518 ± 230 μg/l (77% of the Ala-fraction) at the inlet, and 309 ± 123 μg/l (66% of the Ala-fraction) at
statement: 计算得出的无机单体铝分数（Ali）在入口处为518 ± 230 μg/l（占Ala分数的77%），在出口处为309 ± 123 μg/l（占Ala分数的66%）。
text_zh: 计算得出的无机单体铝分数（Ali）在入口处为518 ± 230 μg/l（占Ala分数的77%），在出口处为309 ± 123 μg/l（占Ala分数的66%）。
text_en: The calculated inorganic monomeric aluminum fraction (Ali) was 518 ± 230 μg/l at the inlet (77% of the Ala fraction) and 309 ± 123 μg/l at the outlet (66% of the Ala fraction).

quote: In the present study, crucian carp was exposed to 385 μg Al i /l.
statement: 本研究中，鲫鱼暴露于 385 μg Al_i/l 的铝浓度。
text_zh: 本研究中，鲫鱼暴露于 385 μg Al_i/l 的铝浓度。
text_en: In this study, crucian carp were exposed to an aluminum concentration of 385 μg Al_i/l.

quote: To our knowledge, no other freshwater fish species have been able to survive exposures to similar Al i -concentrations.
statement: 据作者所知，没有其他淡水鱼种能在类似的 Al_i 浓度下存活。
text_zh: 据作者所知，没有其他淡水鱼种能在类似的 Al_i 浓度下存活。
text_en: To the authors' knowledge, no other freshwater fish species can survive at similar Al_i concentrations.

quote: It has been demonstrated that aluminium was acutely toxic to seven common Scandinavian freshwater fish species at 300 μg Al i /l [ 21 ].
statement: 已有研究证明，在 300 μg Al_i/l 时，铝对七种常见的斯堪的纳维亚淡水鱼具有急性毒性。
text_zh: 已有研究证明，在 300 μg Al_i/l 时，铝对七种常见的斯堪的纳维亚淡水鱼具有急性毒性。
text_en: Existing studies have demonstrated that aluminum is acutely toxic to seven common Scandinavian freshwater fish species at 300 μg Al_i/l.

population.species: seven common Scandinavian freshwater fish species

quote: Our results therefore document that crucian carp can survive Al-exposures substantially more severe than Al-exposures shown to be acutely toxic to other fish species.
statement: 因此，我们的结果记录表明，鲫鱼能够承受比其他鱼类表现出急性毒性的铝暴露严重得多的铝暴露。
text_zh: 因此，我们的结果记录表明，鲫鱼能够承受比其他鱼类表现出急性毒性的铝暴露严重得多的铝暴露。
text_en: Therefore, our recorded results indicate that crucian carp can withstand aluminum exposure much more severe than the aluminum exposure that showed acute toxicity in other fish.

quote: We did not measure the amount of aluminium on the fish gills, but our results revealed no signs of structural damage to the gill surface, even though the conditions for Al-polymerisation and accumulation on the fish gills were more extensive in the present study compared to the earlier study [ 20 ].
statement: 我们没有测量鱼鳃上的铝含量，但我们的结果显示鳃表面没有结构损伤的迹象，尽管与早期研究相比，本研究中鱼鳃上铝聚合和积累的条件更为广泛。
text_zh: 我们没有测量鱼鳃上的铝含量，但我们的结果显示鳃表面没有结构损伤的迹象，尽管与早期研究相比，本研究中鱼鳃上铝聚合和积累的条件更为广泛。
text_en: We did not measure aluminum content on the fish gills, but our results showed no signs of structural damage to the gill surface, although the conditions for aluminum polymerization and accumulation on the fish gills in this study were more extensive than in earlier studies.

quote: It is generally agreed that the decrease in plasma ions in Al-exposed fish is caused by an increased passive efflux across the gill epithelium, as well as a reduction in the active uptake of ions from the surrounding water [ 10 , 23 , 49 – 50 ].
statement: 铝暴露鱼类血浆离子浓度下降通常被认为是由跨鳃上皮的被动外流增加以及从周围水中主动吸收离子的减少引起的。
text_zh: 铝暴露鱼类血浆离子浓度下降通常被认为是由跨鳃上皮的被动外流增加以及从周围水中主动吸收离子的减少引起的。
text_en: The decrease in plasma ion concentrations in fish exposed to aluminum is usually considered to be caused by increased passive efflux across the gill epithelium and decreased active uptake of ions from the surrounding water.
outcome: 离子调节与渗透压平衡

quote: The levelling off of the ion loss that we observed, could be a result of an ability in crucian carp to increase the active uptake of ions, or caused by a decreasing diffusion gradient between blood and the surrounding water as the plasma ion concentrations decrease.
statement: 观察到的离子流失趋于平稳可能是鲫鱼增加主动离子吸收能力的结果，也可能是由于血浆离子浓度降低导致血液与周围水之间的扩散梯度减小所致。
text_zh: 观察到的离子流失趋于平稳可能是鲫鱼增加主动离子吸收能力的结果，也可能是由于血浆离子浓度降低导致血液与周围水之间的扩散梯度减小所致。
text_en: The observed stabilization of ion loss may be the result of crucian carp increasing their active ion uptake capacity, or due to a reduced diffusion gradient between blood and surrounding water caused by decreased plasma ion concentrations.
outcome: 离子调节与渗透压平衡

quote: since the normoxic O 2 -uptake in crucian carp exposed to aluminium did not exceed that of control fish, it seems unlikely that the compensation of ion loss is achieved by an increase in ion transportation, which has been suggested as a mechanism for counteracting ion loss in other fish species during Al-exposure [ 51 ].
statement: 由于暴露于铝的鲫鱼的常氧耗氧量未超过对照鱼，因此通过增加离子运输来补偿离子流失的可能性不大，尽管这曾被建议为其他鱼类在铝暴露期间对抗离子流失的机制。
text_zh: 由于暴露于铝的鲫鱼的常氧耗氧量未超过对照鱼，因此通过增加离子运输来补偿离子流失的可能性不大，尽管这曾被建议为其他鱼类在铝暴露期间对抗离子流失的机制。
text_en: Since the normoxic oxygen consumption of crucian carp exposed to aluminum did not exceed that of control fish, the possibility of compensating for ion loss by increasing ion transport is unlikely, although this has been suggested as a mechanism for other fish species to counteract ion loss during aluminum exposure.
counterevidence: 否定了通过增加离子运输（高能耗过程）来补偿离子流失的假设

quote: It therefore seems more likely that the decreased ion loss rate in Al-exposed crucian carp is a result of a reduced diffusion gradient across the gill epithelium.
statement: 因此，铝暴露鲫鱼离子流失率降低更可能是由于跨鳃上皮扩散梯度减小的结果。
text_zh: 因此，铝暴露鲫鱼离子流失率降低更可能是由于跨鳃上皮扩散梯度减小的结果。
text_en: Therefore, the reduced ion loss rate in crucian carp exposed to aluminum is more likely due to a decreased diffusion gradient across the gill epithelium.
outcome: 离子调节与渗透压平衡

quote: This can be achieved because crucian carp has a small gill surface area compared to other fish species [ 27 ], despite that the gill surface area in Al-exposed crucian carp increased somewhat.
statement: 鲫鱼较小的鳃表面积有助于实现离子平衡，尽管铝暴露后其鳃表面积有所增加。
text_zh: 鲫鱼较小的鳃表面积有助于实现离子平衡，尽管铝暴露后其鳃表面积有所增加。
text_en: The smaller gill surface area of crucian carp helps achieve ion balance, although its gill surface area increased after aluminum exposure.

quote: In general, however, we observed a change in behaviour in fish exposed to aluminium.
statement: 总体而言，观察到暴露于铝的鱼类行为发生变化。
text_zh: 总体而言，观察到暴露于铝的鱼类行为发生变化。
text_en: Overall, changes in fish behavior were observed following exposure to aluminum.

quote: The fish showed a decreasing swimming activity compared to the control fish, and there was less response to handling prior to sampling.
statement: 与对照鱼相比，这些鱼的游泳活动减少，且在采样前对处理的反应较少。
text_zh: 与对照鱼相比，这些鱼的游泳活动减少，且在采样前对处理的反应较少。
text_en: Compared to control fish, these fish showed reduced swimming activity and a lesser response to the treatment before sampling.

quote: The analyses of blood and plasma parameters revealed some negative effects on the physiology in fish exposed to the acidic Al-rich medium (Fig 2).
statement: 血液和血浆参数的分析显示，暴露于酸性富铝介质的鱼类生理机能受到一些负面影响。
text_zh: 血液和血浆参数的分析显示，暴露于酸性富铝介质的鱼类生理机能受到一些负面影响。
text_en: Analysis of blood and plasma parameters showed that the physiological functions of fish exposed to acidic aluminum-rich media were negatively affected to some extent.

quote: Haematocrit in fish exposed to the untreated and the acidic Al-poor water did not change significantly (F 3,24 = 1.094, p = 0.371 and F 3,24 = 1.208, p = 0.328 respectively) during the trials (Fig 2A) and remained between 44.1 ± 1.6% and 49.8 ± 0.8%.
statement: 在试验期间，暴露于未处理水和酸性贫铝水中的鱼的红细胞压积没有显著变化，并保持在44.1 ± 1.6%至49.8 ± 0.8%之间。
text_zh: 在试验期间，暴露于未处理水和酸性贫铝水中的鱼的红细胞压积没有显著变化，并保持在44.1 ± 1.6%至49.8 ± 0.8%之间。
text_en: During the trial, there was no significant change in the hematocrit of fish exposed to untreated water and acidic aluminum-poor water, which remained between 44.1 ± 1.6% and 49.8 ± 0.8%.

quote: However, there was a significant effect of duration of exposure in fish from the acidic Al-rich water (F 3,24 = 7.441, p = 0.001), where haematocrit increased from 44.1 ± 1.0% to 52.2 ± 1.5% between day 2 and 6 (p = 0.001)
statement: 然而，来自酸性富铝水的鱼的暴露持续时间有显著影响，其红细胞压积在第2天到第6天之间从44.1 ± 1.0%增加到52.2 ± 1.5%。
text_zh: 然而，来自酸性富铝水的鱼的暴露持续时间有显著影响，其红细胞压积在第2天到第6天之间从44.1 ± 1.0%增加到52.2 ± 1.5%。
text_en: However, the exposure duration of fish from acidic aluminum-rich water had a significant effect, with their hematocrit increasing from 44.1 ± 1.0% to 52.2 ± 1.5% between day 2 and day 6.

quote: Plasma sodium in fish exposed to untreated and acidic Al-poor water did not change significantly (F 3,24 = 1.991, p = 0.142 and F 3,23 = 0.962, p = 0.427 respectively) during the trials, and remained between 129 ± 1 and 137 ± 3 mM.
statement: 暴露于未处理水和酸性贫铝水中的鱼的血浆钠在试验期间没有显著变化，保持在129 ± 1到137 ± 3 mM之间。
text_zh: 暴露于未处理水和酸性贫铝水中的鱼的血浆钠在试验期间没有显著变化，保持在129 ± 1到137 ± 3 mM之间。
text_en: Plasma sodium in fish exposed to untreated water and acidic aluminum-poor water showed no significant change during the trial, remaining between 129 ± 1 and 137 ± 3 mM.

quote: However, there was a significant effect of duration of exposure in fish from the trial with acidic Al-rich water (F 3,23 = 5.185, p = 0.007), where plasma sodium was significantly lower at day 6 (121 ± 1 mM) (p = 0.050) and day 14 (117 ± 2 mM) (p = 0.005) compared to day 2 (129 ± 4 mM).
statement: In fish exposed to acidic aluminum-rich water, plasma sodium levels were significantly lower on days 6 and 14 compared to day 2.
text_en: In fish exposed to acidic aluminum-rich water, plasma sodium levels were significantly lower on days 6 and 14 compared to day 2.

quote: The muscle water content (MWC) in fish exposed to the acidic Al-poor water did not change significantly (F 3,24 = 1.911, p = 0.155) during the trial, and remained between 3.79 ± 0.02 and 3.86 ± 0.02 ml/g dry weight (dw)
statement: Muscle water content in fish exposed to acidic aluminum-poor water did not change significantly during the trial.
text_en: Muscle water content in fish exposed to acidic aluminum-poor water did not change significantly during the trial.

quote: However, there was a significant effect of duration of exposure in fish from the trial with untreated water as well as fish from the acidic Al-rich water (F 3,24 = 5.757, p = 0.004 and F 3,24 = 6.442, p = 0.002 respectively).
statement: There was a significant effect of exposure duration on muscle water content in fish from both the untreated water and acidic aluminum-rich water trials.
text_en: There was a significant effect of exposure duration on muscle water content in fish from both the untreated water and acidic aluminum-rich water trials.

quote: MWC in fish from the untreated water was significantly lower at day 6 (3.76 ± 0.02 ml/g dw) compared to day 2 and 10 (3.87 ± 0.02; p = 0.010 for both comparisons).
statement: Muscle water content in fish from untreated water was significantly lower on day 6 compared to days 2 and 10.
text_en: Muscle water content in fish from untreated water was significantly lower on day 6 compared to days 2 and 10.

quote: In Al-exposed fish MWC was significantly higher at day 6 (4.04 ± 0.03 ml/g dw) compared to day 2, 10 and 14 (day 14 highest with 3.92 ± 0.03 ml/g dw)
statement: Muscle water content in aluminum-exposed fish was significantly higher on day 6 compared to days 2, 10, and 14.
text_en: Muscle water content in aluminum-exposed fish was significantly higher on day 6 compared to days 2, 10, and 14.

quote: The gills of Al-exposed crucian carp show no signs of structural damage and there were no increase in the critical oxygen tension as a consequence of Al-exposure.
statement: 暴露于铝的鲫鱼鳃部没有显示出结构损伤的迹象，且临界氧张力未因铝暴露而增加。
text_zh: 暴露于铝的鲫鱼鳃部没有显示出结构损伤的迹象，且临界氧张力未因铝暴露而增加。
text_en: Crucian carp gills exposed to aluminum showed no signs of structural damage, and the critical oxygen tension did not increase due to aluminum exposure.

quote: Moreover, only small and transient changes in haematocrit, plasma lactate, and blood ethanol indicated that the aluminium did not cause hypoxia in crucian carp.
statement: 红细胞压积、血浆乳酸和血液乙醇仅出现微小且短暂的变化，表明铝并未导致鲫鱼缺氧。
text_zh: 红细胞压积、血浆乳酸和血液乙醇仅出现微小且短暂的变化，表明铝并未导致鲫鱼缺氧。
text_en: Hematocrit, plasma lactate, and blood ethanol showed only minor and transient changes, indicating that aluminum did not cause hypoxia in crucian carp.

quote: However, the oxygen uptake was reduced in Al-exposed crucian carp, which could be assigned to a lowering of metabolism due to local hypoxia at the gill surface.
statement: 然而，暴露于铝的鲫鱼的摄氧量降低，这可能归因于鳃表面局部缺氧导致的代谢率下降。
text_zh: 然而，暴露于铝的鲫鱼的摄氧量降低，这可能归因于鳃表面局部缺氧导致的代谢率下降。
text_en: However, oxygen consumption decreased in crucian carp exposed to aluminum, which may be attributed to a decrease in metabolic rate caused by local hypoxia on the gill surface.

quote: Furthermore, Al-exposure caused a net loss of plasma chloride and sodium in crucian carp.
statement: 此外，铝暴露导致鲫鱼血浆中氯化物和钠的净流失。
text_zh: 此外，铝暴露导致鲫鱼血浆中氯化物和钠的净流失。
text_en: In addition, aluminum exposure caused a net loss of chloride and sodium in the plasma of crucian carp.

quote: When fish are exposed to ongoing Al-polymerisation, aluminium will accumulate on the gills [ 10 , 16 , 44 ], leading to an increased secretion of mucus on the gill surface [ 35 , 45 – 46 ].
statement: 当鱼类暴露于持续的铝聚合过程中时，铝会在鳃上积累，导致鳃表面粘液分泌增加。
text_zh: 当鱼类暴露于持续的铝聚合过程中时，铝会在鳃上积累，导致鳃表面粘液分泌增加。
text_en: When fish are exposed to continuous aluminium polymerisation, aluminium accumulates on the gills, leading to increased mucus secretion on the gill surface.

quote: Consequently, the diffusion barrier for oxygen will increase [ 47 ], resulting in local hypoxia at the gill surface, which can be detected by the external O 2 -receptors in the gills.
statement: 因此，氧气扩散屏障会增加，导致鳃表面局部缺氧，这可以被鳃中的外部O2受体检测到。
text_zh: 因此，氧气扩散屏障会增加，导致鳃表面局部缺氧，这可以被鳃中的外部O2受体检测到。
text_en: Therefore, the oxygen diffusion barrier increases, leading to local hypoxia on the gill surface, which can be detected by external O2 receptors in the gills.

quote: Overall, the results from the present study support the suggestion that the crucian carp is able to meet its O 2 -demand when exposed to an Al-challenge that would lead to acute asphyxiation in other freshwater fish species.
statement: 总体而言，本研究的结果支持这样的观点：鲫鱼能够满足其氧气需求，即使暴露在会导致其他淡水鱼种急性窒息的铝挑战中。
text_zh: 总体而言，本研究的结果支持这样的观点：鲫鱼能够满足其氧气需求，即使暴露在会导致其他淡水鱼种急性窒息的铝挑战中。
text_en: Overall, the results of this study support the view that crucian carp can meet their oxygen requirements even when exposed to aluminium challenges that would cause acute asphyxiation in other freshwater fish species.

quote: In addition, we suggest that the increased gill surface area is the reason why the critical O 2 -tension did not increase in Al-exposed fish.
statement: 此外，我们建议增加的鳃表面积是铝暴露鱼类的临界氧张力没有增加的原因。
text_zh: 此外，我们建议增加的鳃表面积是铝暴露鱼类的临界氧张力没有增加的原因。
text_en: In addition, we suggest that the increased gill surface area is the reason why the critical oxygen tension of aluminium-exposed fish did not increase.

quote: Increasing the gill surface as a response to hypoxia/anoxia will have an effect on the osmo-respiratory compromise [ 48 ].
statement: 作为对低氧/无氧的反应而增加鳃表面积会影响渗透-呼吸权衡。
text_zh: 作为对低氧/无氧的反应而增加鳃表面积会影响渗透-呼吸权衡。
text_en: Increasing gill surface area in response to hypoxia/anoxia affects the osmoregulation-respiration trade-off.

quote: Hence, the present study documents that ion regulation is affected in crucian carp exposed to high concentrations of toxic aluminium.
statement: 因此，本研究表明，暴露于高浓度有毒铝的鲫鱼的离子调节受到影响。
text_zh: 因此，本研究表明，暴露于高浓度有毒铝的鲫鱼的离子调节受到影响。
text_en: Therefore, this study shows that ion regulation in crucian carp exposed to high concentrations of toxic aluminium was affected.

quote: In contrast to previous studies on fish showing that the levels of plasma ions decrease continuously during Al-exposures [ 25 , 45 ], our results show that both plasma chloride and sodium stabilises at a lower level, compared to control, after an initial decrease.
statement: 与之前显示血浆离子水平在铝暴露期间持续下降的研究相反，我们的结果显示，在初始下降后，血浆氯和钠均稳定在低于对照组的水平。
text_zh: 与之前显示血浆离子水平在铝暴露期间持续下降的研究相反，我们的结果显示，在初始下降后，血浆氯和钠均稳定在低于对照组的水平。
text_en: Contrary to previous studies showing that plasma ion levels continued to decline during aluminium exposure, our results showed that after an initial decline, both plasma chloride and sodium stabilized at levels lower than those of the control group.

quote: The results from the present study confirm that crucian carp survives exposure to substantial amounts of toxic aluminium.
statement: 本研究结果证实，鲫鱼能够耐受大量有毒铝的暴露。
text_zh: 本研究结果证实，鲫鱼能够耐受大量有毒铝的暴露。
text_en: The results of this study confirm that crucian carp can tolerate exposure to large amounts of toxic aluminum.

quote: However, the exposure to aluminium during ongoing polymerisation did have an effect on the physiology of the crucian carp, and it was different from previous observations in other fish species exposed to aluminium.
statement: 在聚合反应进行期间暴露于铝确实对鲫鱼的生理机能产生了影响，且这种影响与其他鱼类暴露于铝时的先前观察结果不同。
text_zh: 在聚合反应进行期间暴露于铝确实对鲫鱼的生理机能产生了影响，且这种影响与其他鱼类暴露于铝时的先前观察结果不同。
text_en: Exposure to aluminum during polymerization did affect the physiological functions of crucian carp, and this effect differed from previous observations when other fish species were exposed to aluminum.

quote: In agreement with a previous study [ 20 ], our results show that crucian carp has a high tolerance to aluminium.
statement: 与先前的研究一致，我们的结果显示鲫鱼对铝具有高耐受性。
text_zh: 与先前的研究一致，我们的结果显示鲫鱼对铝具有高耐受性。
text_en: Consistent with previous studies, our results show that crucian carp have high tolerance to aluminum.

quote: In fact, the present study has documented that crucian carp can survive exposures to more than twice the concentrations of aluminium, approximately 970 μg/l, compared to approximately 400 μg/l used in an earlier study [ 20 ].
statement: 事实上，本研究表明，与早期研究中使用的约400微克/升相比，鲫鱼可以存活于浓度超过两倍（约970微克/升）的铝暴露中。
text_zh: 事实上，本研究表明，与早期研究中使用的约400微克/升相比，鲫鱼可以存活于浓度超过两倍（约970微克/升）的铝暴露中。
text_en: In fact, this study shows that crucian carp can survive aluminum exposure at concentrations more than twice (about 970 µg/L) the approximately 400 µg/L used in earlier studies.

quote: In the present study crucian carp was also exposed to a larger degree of ongoing Al-polymerisation than previously [ 20 ], conditions in which Al-toxicity in fish is most severe [ 10 , 16 ].
statement: 在本研究中，鲫鱼还暴露于比以前更大程度的持续铝聚合过程中，在这种条件下鱼类的铝毒性最为严重。
text_zh: 在本研究中，鲫鱼还暴露于比以前更大程度的持续铝聚合过程中，在这种条件下鱼类的铝毒性最为严重。
text_en: In this study, crucian carp were also exposed to a greater degree of continuous aluminum polymerization than previously, under which conditions the aluminum toxicity to fish was most severe.

quote: Between day 6 and 10 haematocrit decreased significantly (Fig 2A) in fish exposed to the acidic Al-rich medium (p = 0.035), and ended up at 47.6 ± 1.1% on day 14, not significantly different from the two other groups (p > 0.220).
statement: 在第6天至第10天之间，暴露于酸性富铝介质中的鱼的血细胞比容显著下降，并在第14天达到47.6 ± 1.1%，与其他两组无显著差异。
text_zh: 在第6天至第10天之间，暴露于酸性富铝介质中的鱼的血细胞比容显著下降，并在第14天达到47.6 ± 1.1%，与其他两组无显著差异。
text_en: Between day 6 and day 10, the hematocrit of fish exposed to acidic aluminum-rich medium decreased significantly, reaching 47.6 ± 1.1% on day 14, with no significant difference from the other two groups.

quote: Moreover, haematocrit did not differ between fish exposed to untreated and acidic Al-poor water (p > 0.959) except on day 14 when haematocrit in fish in the untreated water was significantly higher compared to the other sampling days (p = 0.041).
statement: 此外，暴露于未处理水和酸性贫铝水中的鱼的血细胞比容没有差异，除了第14天未处理水中的鱼的血细胞比容显著高于其他采样日。
text_zh: 此外，暴露于未处理水和酸性贫铝水中的鱼的血细胞比容没有差异，除了第14天未处理水中的鱼的血细胞比容显著高于其他采样日。
text_en: In addition, there was no difference in hematocrit between fish exposed to untreated water and acidic low-aluminum water, except that the hematocrit of fish in untreated water on day 14 was significantly higher than on other sampling days.

quote: Plasma chloride in fish exposed to untreated and acidic Al-poor water did not change significantly (F 3,24 0.178) during the trials (Fig 2B), and remained between 99 ± 3 and 103 ± 1 mM.
statement: 暴露于未处理水和酸性贫铝水中的鱼的血浆氯化物在试验期间没有显著变化，保持在99 ± 3到103 ± 1 mM之间。
text_zh: 暴露于未处理水和酸性贫铝水中的鱼的血浆氯化物在试验期间没有显著变化，保持在99 ± 3到103 ± 1 mM之间。
text_en: Plasma chloride in fish exposed to untreated water and acidic low-aluminum water did not change significantly during the trial, remaining between 99 ± 3 and 103 ± 1 mM.

quote: However, there was a significant effect of exposure in fish from the trial with acidic Al-rich water (F 3,23 = 6.172, p = 0.003), where plasma chloride decreased from 91 ± 2 to 82 ± 2 mM between day 2 and 6 (p = 0.014).
statement: 然而，在酸性富铝水试验中，暴露对鱼有显著影响，血浆氯化物在第2天至第6天期间从91 ± 2 mM下降到82 ± 2 mM。
text_zh: 然而，在酸性富铝水试验中，暴露对鱼有显著影响，血浆氯化物在第2天至第6天期间从91 ± 2 mM下降到82 ± 2 mM。
text_en: However, in the acidic aluminum-rich water test, exposure had a significant effect on fish, with plasma chloride decreasing from 91 ± 2 mM to 82 ± 2 mM between day 2 and day 6.

quote: On the other hand, the lack of a continued elevation in haematocrit, plasma lactate and blood ethanol, support the opinion that Al-exposed crucian carp did not become hypoxic.
statement: 红细胞压积、血浆乳酸和血液乙醇没有持续升高，支持了暴露于铝的鲫鱼未发生缺氧的观点。
text_zh: 红细胞压积、血浆乳酸和血液乙醇没有持续升高，支持了暴露于铝的鲫鱼未发生缺氧的观点。
text_en: Hematocrit, plasma lactate, and blood ethanol did not remain elevated, supporting the view that crucian carp exposed to aluminum did not experience hypoxia.

quote: Moreover, the present study documents that the critical oxygen tension for crucian carp did not increase as a consequence of exposure to aluminium, indicating that O 2 -consumption was not restricted.
statement: 本研究记录显示，鲫鱼的临界氧张力并未因暴露于铝而增加，表明氧气消耗未受到限制。
text_zh: 本研究记录显示，鲫鱼的临界氧张力并未因暴露于铝而增加，表明氧气消耗未受到限制。
text_en: This study's records show that the critical oxygen tension of crucian carp did not increase due to exposure to aluminum, indicating that oxygen consumption was not limited.

quote: The increased gill surface area and the reduced O 2 -uptake in Al-exposed crucian carp do not agree with the statement that crucian carp exposed to aluminium does not become hypoxic.
statement: 暴露于铝的鲫鱼鳃表面积增加和氧气摄取减少，与暴露于铝的鲫鱼不会缺氧的说法不一致。
text_zh: 暴露于铝的鲫鱼鳃表面积增加和氧气摄取减少，与暴露于铝的鲫鱼不会缺氧的说法不一致。
text_en: Increased gill surface area and reduced oxygen uptake in crucian carp exposed to aluminum are inconsistent with the claim that crucian carp exposed to aluminum do not become hypoxic.
outcome: 鳃结构/氧气摄取/缺氧风险

quote: This contradiction can be explained by a reduction in metabolic rate.
statement: 这种矛盾可以通过代谢率的降低来解释。
text_zh: 这种矛盾可以通过代谢率的降低来解释。
text_en: This contradiction can be explained by a decrease in metabolic rate.

quote: In our study, the initial reduction in plasma ion concentrations in Al-exposed crucian carp seems to be followed by a short transient increase in haematocrit and muscle water content (MWC) (Fig 2).
statement: 本研究中，铝暴露鲫鱼血浆离子浓度初始降低后，血细胞比容和肌肉含水量出现短暂升高。
text_zh: 本研究中，铝暴露鲫鱼血浆离子浓度初始降低后，血细胞比容和肌肉含水量出现短暂升高。
text_en: In this study, after the initial decrease in plasma ion concentrations of crucian carp exposed to aluminum, hematocrit and muscle water content showed a transient increase.

quote: These transient changes correspond with the reduced ion loss rate observed.
statement: 这些短暂变化与观察到的离子流失率降低相对应。
text_zh: 这些短暂变化与观察到的离子流失率降低相对应。
text_en: These transient changes correspond to the observed reduction in ion loss rates.

quote: Thus, the decrease in both haematocrit and MWC, back to control levels when the net efflux of ions ceased, suggests that the crucian carp were able to recover from a transient volume regulatory disturbance.
statement: 因此，当净离子流失停止时，血细胞比容和肌肉含水量均恢复至对照水平，表明鲫鱼能够从短暂的体积调节紊乱中恢复。
text_zh: 因此，当净离子流失停止时，血细胞比容和肌肉含水量均恢复至对照水平，表明鲫鱼能够从短暂的体积调节紊乱中恢复。
text_en: Therefore, when net ion loss ceased, hematocrit and muscle water content both returned to control levels, indicating that crucian carp can recover from transient volume regulation disturbances.

quote: This suggestion is supported by an earlier study reporting no change in haematocrit in Al-exposed crucian carp [ 20 ]
statement: An earlier study reported no change in hematocrit in aluminum-exposed crucian carp.
text_en: An earlier study reported no change in hematocrit in aluminum-exposed crucian carp.

quote: mortality in copper exposed crucian carp did not occur before levels of plasma chloride had decreased to 40% of control levels [ 28 ]
statement: Mortality in copper-exposed crucian carp did not occur until plasma chloride levels dropped to 40% of control levels.
text_en: Mortality in copper-exposed crucian carp did not occur until plasma chloride levels dropped to 40% of control levels.

quote: In the present study, and an earlier study [ 20 ], the plasma chloride reduction in Al-exposed crucian carp levelled off at approximately 80% of control levels
statement: Plasma chloride reduction in aluminum-exposed crucian carp leveled off at approximately 80% of control levels.
text_en: Plasma chloride reduction in aluminum-exposed crucian carp leveled off at approximately 80% of control levels.

quote: It can be argued that this could be the reason why Al-exposed fish responded different from the fish in the two other groups
statement: Higher water temperature in the aluminum-rich trial could explain the different response of aluminum-exposed fish compared to other groups.
text_en: Higher water temperature in the aluminum-rich trial could explain the different response of aluminum-exposed fish compared to other groups.

quote: Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) exposed to different temperatures between 1 and 19°C in an Al-poor medium did not show any significant difference in blood haematocrit, plasma osmolality and plasma concentrations of sodium and chloride [ 45 ]
statement: Atlantic salmon exposed to temperatures between 1 and 19°C in low-aluminum media showed no significant differences in blood hematocrit, plasma osmolality, or sodium/chloride concentrations.
text_en: Atlantic salmon exposed to temperatures between 1 and 19°C in low-aluminum media showed no significant differences in blood hematocrit, plasma osmolality, or sodium/chloride concentrations.

quote: Water conductivity was measured with a Radiometer CDM 80 conductivity meter.
statement: 水的电导率使用Radiometer CDM 80电导率仪进行测量。
text_zh: 水的电导率使用Radiometer CDM 80电导率仪进行测量。
text_en: The electrical conductivity of the water was measured using a Radiometer CDM 80 conductivity meter.

quote: Plasma lactate concentration was measured enzymatically using a Lactate Analyser TDx.

text_en: The fact that crucian carp appear to avoid hypoxia and exhibit only mild symptoms of aluminum toxicity is consistent with the hypothesis that hypoxia is the primary effect of fish exposure to aluminum, particularly under conditions favoring aluminum polymerization and accumulation on the gill surface.

text_en: As the dose of enrofloxacin increased, IBRv2 values gradually rose, indicating that the stress response induced by enrofloxacin is positively correlated with dose, and its toxicity to fish brain is dose-dependent.

quote: The liver, being the primary detoxification organ in the body, is particularly vulnerable to impairment and toxicity from MPs, making it a main target for these contaminants, entering the liver tissue through circulation [ 9 ], inducing inflammation in liver tissue cells, and interfering with the normal metabolism of the liver [ 10 ], resulting in varying degrees of pathology.
statement: 肝脏作为主要解毒器官，易受微塑料损害和毒性影响，微塑料通过循环进入肝组织，诱导肝细胞炎症并干扰正常代谢，导致不同程度的病理变化。
text_zh: 肝脏作为主要解毒器官，易受微塑料损害和毒性影响，微塑料通过循环进入肝组织，诱导肝细胞炎症并干扰正常代谢，导致不同程度的病理变化。
text_en: The liver, as the main detoxification organ, is susceptible to damage and toxicity from microplastics; microplastics enter liver tissue via circulation, induce hepatocyte inflammation and interfere with normal metabolism, leading to varying degrees of pathological changes.

quote: In this paper, we used polystyrene microplastics (PS-MPs) as an exposure source to realistically reflect the effects of MPs on the liver of fish in the natural environment by simulating the liver response of fish after ingestion of MPs.
statement: 本研究使用聚苯乙烯微塑料作为暴露源，通过模拟鱼类摄入微塑料后的肝脏反应，以真实反映自然环境中微塑料对鱼肝的影响。

text_en: This study used polystyrene microplastics as the exposure source to simulate the liver response of fish after ingesting microplastics, in order to truly reflect the impact of microplastics on fish livers in the natural environment.

quote: Through a 32 d exposure experiment, we analyzed the effects of MPs on the cellular morphology and immune function of the liver tissue of crucian carp larvae, and investigated the mechanism of the liver response to microplastics in crucian carp juveniles, as well as the intrinsic linkage of the physiological activities of the liver under PS-MPs contamination at the cellular, protein, and molecular levels.
statement: 通过为期32天的暴露实验，分析了微塑料对鲫鱼幼鱼肝脏组织细胞形态和免疫功能的影响，并研究了鲫鱼稚鱼肝脏对微塑料的反应机制以及PS-MPs污染下肝脏生理活动在细胞、蛋白质和分子水平上的内在联系。
text_zh: 通过为期32天的暴露实验，分析了微塑料对鲫鱼幼鱼肝脏组织细胞形态和免疫功能的影响，并研究了鲫鱼稚鱼肝脏对微塑料的反应机制以及PS-MPs污染下肝脏生理活动在细胞、蛋白质和分子水平上的内在联系。
text_en: Through a 32-day exposure experiment, the effects of microplastics on liver tissue cell morphology and immune function in juvenile crucian carp were analyzed, and the response mechanism of the liver of young crucian carp to microplastics as well as the intrinsic links of liver physiological activity at the cellular, protein, and molecular levels under PS-MPs pollution were studied.
outcome: 肝脏细胞形态与免疫功能
